title: Overlapping defects in a synthetic quality fixture
method: Synthetic 1,000-row fixture has 40 status defects,30 identifier defects and 10 overlapping records. Inclusion-exclusion gives 40+30−10=60 distinct rejected and 940 passing these two checks. Counts are not independent or additive; no real defect rate is claimed.
alt: Overlapping defects in a synthetic quality fixture. Invalid status: 40 records; Missing identifier: 30 records; Both defects: 10 records; Distinct rejected: 60 records. Illustrative values.
